Reef Route

The floor is now built, not painted: every plant and coral is its own traced SVG, planted on a sand line I draw, on a tile that repeats exactly. Sprout is his live SVG rig. Nothing is a bitmap.

Waking Sprout…Demo: a length is 60 s here, 90 s in the app.

What changed

Built floorEach kelp clump, coral, starfish and shell is a separate traced SVG. I draw the sand line as a gentle wave and plant each piece 6 pt into it, so nothing floats and nothing is sliced.
Exact loopThe floor tile is 660 pt wide and the sand wave has that same period, so the tile joins itself. The scroll wraps at exactly one tile: nothing appears or vanishes mid-screen.
Front layerA single drawn dune in front, no clipping, no plants.
Chest and submarineA treasure chest every three lengths on a second bare stretch, nothing behind or in front of it. A small yellow submarine joins the far passers now and then.
All or nothingLike Focus Friend: coins pile up as "waiting" and are paid only when the whole shift ends. Clocking out early leaves them in the reef, with one wave and no scolding. This replaces the app's current "paid for minutes worked" rule.
No shadowGone. The arch sits on the measured sand line. He sleeps on it too.

The sequence

EventWhat happensRig emote
Clock inOne wave, then the reef starts to roll.wave
SwimmingSprout holds his lane above the kelp. Reef, fish and rays move.idle: fins, blink, breath
Every 3 minA treasure chest sits on its own bare stretch of sand and rolls past with the reef. No coins: coins are for finishing.—
Every 90 sThe arch rolls in on the sand. As he passes over it: one bounce, lengths +1.bounce
PauseEverything freezes. He settles onto the sand and sleeps.sleep
ResumeWakes with a surprise, back up to his lane.surprise
FinishCheer. Every coin from the shift flies to the wallet at once.cheer
Clock out earlyOne wave. The coins this shift would have paid stay in the reef. No guilt screen.wave
